selection_rules: The chat host (Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, Kimi, Grok Build) is not a generator id and must not select a profile by itself.
Do not default Grok to GPT Image 2.5. Bind generate/edit only to tools actually present in the session.
Use Sunburst for complex/reference-sensitive work only when the session tool is a registered 2.5 profile or the user explicitly requests that model.
Use Flare when faster everyday generation is the declared trade-off and the session tool is a registered 2.5 profile.
If the requested model/surface is not a registered 2.5 profile, use generic-image and omit unverified parameters.
Pass only parameters the bound tool accepts. Do not invent model IDs, settings, or untested capabilities.
Do not use a streaming mode for registered 2.5 profiles without a live proof that resolves the source conflict.
Do not claim input_fidelity behavior; it is UNKNOWN/UNTESTED.
